plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Art - Design A.A. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 19, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7935/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local GE. Map states Total Units 60-61; lower bound 60 used = 15+14+16+15 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 2 Area L7B 2-3 -> 2). List A (minimum 6 units): ART 301 or ART 338, ART 325 (requires ART 320 or placement by assessment), ARTNM 324 (advisory: ART 300, ART 320, CISC 302, or JOUR 330) — one 3-unit selection sequenced in each of Semesters 3 and 4; a different course per slot; map recommends ART 325 or ARTNM 324. List B (minimum 3 units): ARTH C1100, ARTH 309 (advisory ENGL C1000), ARTH 311, ARTH 312, ARTH 332 (advisory ENGL C1000) — one 3-unit selection sequenced in each of Semesters 2 and 3 (map recommends ARTH 309 for the Semester 2 slot and ARTH 311 for the Semester 3 slot; ARTH 311 is also a required course in Semester 3, so a different List B course should be chosen there). Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation.
